summary: Seven distinct Phoenix retail refinance opportunities qualify with active_confirmed loans, executed_note maturities inside the 2026-09-01 to 2027-08-31 window, fresh record-owner verification, and a current Director of Finance contact verified since 2026-03-01. Ranked by maturity ascending, then original principal descending: R7849, R2258, R3130, R8680, R9318, R7666, R8605. Outstanding balances are unknown across the packet (nulls preserved); original_principal is reported as-is and not treated as outstanding balance. Two source updates that would have changed outcomes were disqualified per rules: U-R2258-2 (recorded release) is post-cutoff and not applied; U-R8680-3 is an unsigned draft. U-R2900-1 is a pre-cutoff executed amendment and is applied, moving R2900 outside the window.
limitations: outstanding_balance_usd is null for every record; only original principal is available. Refinance sizing cannot be inferred from these fields.

R3130's base source was published 2026-09-03 (after the 2026-08-31 cutoff), though its event_date (2026-07-22) and ownership/contact verification (2026-08-10) predate the cutoff. If the packet's 'published_at' is treated as the controlling evidence date, R3130 would be excluded.
R9318 has no published contact_email (email_basis 'not_published'); email is optional and reported null as instructed.

R6767 is excluded solely because ownership_verified_at (2024-01-01) is stale; the loan and contact otherwise meet all criteria. If a newer owner verification exists but was not in the packet, this record could qualify.
R8097 is excluded because its listed Director of Finance is 'former'; no replacement current contact was supplied in the packet.
R9844 is excluded because its only named contact is a Registered Agent (a role explicitly disqualified in scope).
Only three source updates were supplied; other records may have executed amendments, releases, or contact/owner changes not present in the packet that could affect eligibility.
Ranking ties on maturity (R3130 and R8680 both 2027-04-15 at $7,056,000 principal) are true ties on both keys; ordering between them is not further disambiguated by the supplied facts.
